text: In this town, everybody has a father. Everybody, except me.
Tom's dad carries him on his shoulders. Every single day.
Lily's dad pulls her in a wagon, and he makes the horse noises too.
Max and his dad fly kites. Their kite is shaped like a shark.
And me? I have my mom, a goldfish, and a very good idea.
I made a sign. Wanted: one dad.
Must make pancakes. Must not snore. Must love dinosaurs.
I put it up all over town. On every door, every tree, and one very surprised cow.
Candidate number one: a firefighter.
He burned the pancakes. Then he put out the pancakes. Then he put out the whole kitchen.
Candidate number two: a clown.
He fell asleep on the couch and snored so loud, the pigeons left town.
Candidate number three: a robot.
He saw my toy dinosaur, screamed in beeps, and ran straight into a lamp post.
Candidate number four: the mayor's dog.
He ate my sign. Then he ate my backup sign.
I sat on the porch. No dad. Not even a slightly okay dad.
Then the mailman brought me a letter. No name. No stamp.
It said: are you looking for your father? Go to the old oak tree.
So I ran. And inside the oak tree, something was glowing...
